Agentic Evaluations

How do you know if your agent is smart or just lucky? Measuring performance beyond simple RAG accuracy.

LLM Evals vs. Agent Evals

LLM Evals check if the model generated good text ("Is the summary concise?"). Agent Evals check if the agent took the right actions ("Did it actually update the database?").

Trajectory Evaluation

We inspect the Trajectory: the sequence of thoughts and tool calls.

  • Efficiency: Did it use 3 tool calls when 1 would suffice?
  • Tool Usage: Did it pass the correct arguments?
  • Loop detection: Did it get stuck repeating the same error?

Frameworks

Tools like LangSmith or **Arize Phoenix** allow you to record every step of the agent's graph execution and run automated evaluators over the traces.
